profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at ALKU
profile.summary: A seasoned Senior Software Engineer with nine years of hands-on experience crafting robust and scalable software solutions tailored to meet diverse business needs. Proficient in Java, Python, and JavaScript, I've honed my skills in full-stack development and agile methodologies. My track record includes successfully leading teams, fostering collaboration, and consistently delivering high-quality products on time. I thrive on solving intricate technical puzzles and am eager to apply my expertise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented scalable, multi-tier Java/Spring services supporting mission planning, scheduling, and analysis.
Developed full-stack features using Javascript and React to improve operator workflows and mission awareness.
Improved system responsiveness and stability by refactoring critical Java/Spring services and expanding automated test coverage, reducing recurring production issues.
Integrated MySQL and MongoDB data stores to support high-throughput mission data and analytics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned end-to-end design and development of full-stack features using TypeScript and Java, delivering production-ready capabilities for a complex, data-driven system. 
    • Built and upgraded Angular components and services, improving maintainability, reliability, and overall frontend performance 
    • Partnered with software architects on system design decisions, translating architectural vision into scalable, production-ready implementations. 
    • Collaborated closely with stakeholders and end users to refine requirements and rapidly incorporate feedback, improving usability and overall system effectiveness
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Angular · Java · Full-Stack Development · Web Engineering · Software Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead the team to ensure that the project’s vision was according to what the Product Owners envisioned, and ensured the product exceeded what was committed to.
Worked with an Agile Scrum team to continuously integrate and deliver powerful software.
Helped form a new program and team in Raytheon IIS, and helped to guide and lead new team members as our team grew.
Integrated several new software technologies into the baseline.
Used Docker and Kubernetes to properly orchestrate and deploy a diverse code stack and baseline.
Helped to establish a baseline of code for a full micro service based stack consisting of Java, Javascript, and Postgresql.
Ensured continuous delivery, deployment, and integration in a high paced setting.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript

positions.title: SDET
positions.description:
My responsibilities include:
-Being responsible for creating and maintaining a series of automated test suites for Web and Android products
-Working closely with off-shore support teams to analyze test results and ensure data integrity
-Having a working knowledge of automation approaches, processes, and tools
-Utilizing Selenium and products RESTful web services to create web client and server side test automation through Robot Framework
-Utilizing Google's uiautomator APIs to automate test cases for the Android product and combining with web automation to fully test and automate Android MDM software

positions.title: English Tutor/Teacher
positions.description: Provided mentor-ship and guidance to students in English

honors.issuer: Issued by Florida Atlantic University · Dec 2010

projects.title: Popular Movies Android Application
projects.description: Made an android app that will gather data from an external API to show the user a list of popular movies, which the user can sort by popularity or rating.

projects.title: Senior Design Project: Child Drone
projects.description: This senior design project has the goal of creating a small autonomous drone that will be carried on top of another larger autonomous drone. The child drone will be tasked with gathering data from the environment autonomously before returning to the mother drone, where the data will be collected and processed.
